metadata.description: Agent Skills published by Rafe Blandford.

plugins.name: using-rafeblandford-com
plugins.description: Find out what Rafe Blandford has done, written or can evidence, using rafeblandford.com's three agent interfaces — an MCP endpoint for reasoning about his career, a public Content API for bulk retrieval, and llms.txt/Markdown for crawling. Use when asked to assess him for a role, brief someone before a meeting, find his position on a topic, check whether he has experience of something, read his writing, or ingest the site — and instead of scraping the HTML.
